audit: all bare-pattern candidates, accepted/rejected reasons, parent/reset events and before/after region state; raw source character spans
bare_title: 1..12 words; <=120 characters; v1 title-case/letter/hyphen/apostrophe/& grammar; no numbers, terminal punctuation or page references
eligibility: exact standalone parent; first bare note must be 1 on the parent page; thereafter strictly next integer; no gaps/repeats/backward acceptance; repeated parent preserves chain
eligibility_resets: new report; every v1 reset; blank/navigation/footer-only page; observed Item boundary; no eligibility from prose mentions or future pages
known_limits: title-shaped sequential lists inside an eligible notes region remain ambiguous; missing/wrapped/unsupported note 1 prevents chain start; gaps keep later numbers rejected while the expected next integer is missing; no generic/prose heading cleanup
region_state: recognition only; parent page and last bare-note number; no heading text, year, unit or value propagation

section_v1_policy.candidate_limits: <=32 stopword tokens and <=240 normalized characters; risk sentences <=2 consecutive raw lines, second starts lowercase, ending period
section_v1_policy.continuation: last observed local heading to next physical page only; opening span ends at first heading/reset; no chaining or future pages
section_v1_policy.duplicates: normalized casefold heading text once per page; observed/inherited entries retained with rejection reasons
section_v1_policy.ranking: unchanged expansion BM25 body score + 0.25 * separate heading BM25 score; all physical pages; (-score,page_index)
section_v1_policy.resets: new report; blank/navigation/footer-only text; contents listing; signatures/index-to-exhibits; standalone top-three-line exhibit; filing cover

rules.pattern: (?i)^(?:Consolidated (?:Statements? of .+|Balance Sheets?)|Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements)(?:\s*\(continued\))?$

section_v1_policy.scope: raw Unicode offsets [start,end); local spans end at next heading/reset; inherited spans are weak inference
section_v1_policy.title_rule: 2..12 words; <=120 characters; letters/hyphens/apostrophes/& only; title case or all caps; no terminal punctuation
section_v1_policy.token_budget: frozen stopword tokenizer; complete headings only; source/scope order; skip overflow
section_v1_policy.variables: no year/currency/unit propagation; no adjacency, question cleanup, ledger or model calls

unchanged: v1 scopes, one-page continuation, duplicate policy, 64-token cap, 0.25 weight, BM25, stopwords, tokenization, expansion v1, full candidates and zero-based IDs
